## DEXSeq Analysis - GSE67333

```{r}
library(DEXSeq)
library(tidyverse)
library(BiocParallel)

BPPARAM_GSE67333 <- MulticoreParam(workers = 4)
out_dir_GSE67333 <- file.path("results", "DEXSeqGSE67333")
dir.create(out_dir_GSE67333, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r}
load(file = "/home/projects/22140/exam_data/exam_functions.Rdata")

if (file.exists("data/processed/GSE67333/isoform_counts.rds")) {
  isoform_counts_GSE67333 <- readRDS("data/processed/GSE67333/isoform_counts.rds")
} else {
  isoform_counts_GSE67333 <- loadIsoformCountMatrix("GSE67333")
}

metadata_GSE67333 <- readr::read_csv("data/metadata/GSE67333_metadata_clean.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

tx2gene_df_GSE67333 <- readr::read_rds(
  "/home/projects/22140/exam_data/Homo_sapiens.GRCh38.107.chr_patch_hapl_scaff_tx_info.Rds"
) |> 
  dplyr::select(transcript_id, gene_id) |> 
  dplyr::distinct(transcript_id, .keep_all = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# prepare integer count matrix and align sample metadata
count_matrix_GSE67333 <- round(as.matrix(isoform_counts_GSE67333))

# align metadata rows to match count matrix column order
stopifnot(all(colnames(count_matrix_GSE67333) %in% metadata_GSE67333$sample_id))
metadata_GSE67333 <- metadata_GSE67333[match(colnames(count_matrix_GSE67333), metadata_GSE67333$sample_id), ]

sample_data_GSE67333 <- data.frame(
  row.names = metadata_GSE67333$sample_id,
  sample = factor(metadata_GSE67333$sample_id),
  condition = factor(metadata_GSE67333$condition, levels = c("Control", "AD")),
  sex = factor(tolower(metadata_GSE67333$sex)),
  age_scaled = as.numeric(scale(metadata_GSE67333$age))
)
```

```{r}
# align transcript-to-gene annotation 1-to-1 and filter features
tx2gene_GSE67333 <- tx2gene_df_GSE67333 |> 
  dplyr::filter(transcript_id %in% rownames(count_matrix_GSE67333)) |> 
  dplyr::arrange(match(transcript_id, rownames(count_matrix_GSE67333)))

count_matrix_GSE67333 <- count_matrix_GSE67333[tx2gene_GSE67333$transcript_id, ]

# filter low-count isoforms first (>= 10 counts in at least 4 of the 8 samples)
keep_expr_GSE67333 <- rowSums(count_matrix_GSE67333 >= 10) >= 4
count_matrix_GSE67333 <- count_matrix_GSE67333[keep_expr_GSE67333, ]
tx2gene_GSE67333 <- tx2gene_GSE67333[keep_expr_GSE67333, ]

# keep only genes that still have >= 2 expressed isoforms
multi_iso_genes_GSE67333 <- tx2gene_GSE67333 |> 
  dplyr::count(gene_id) |> 
  dplyr::filter(n >= 2) |> 
  dplyr::pull(gene_id)

keep_tx_GSE67333 <- tx2gene_GSE67333$gene_id %in% multi_iso_genes_GSE67333
count_matrix_GSE67333 <- count_matrix_GSE67333[keep_tx_GSE67333, ]
tx2gene_GSE67333 <- tx2gene_GSE67333[keep_tx_GSE67333, ]
```

```{r}
# build DEXSeqDataSet object including sex and age confounders
dxd_GSE67333 <- DEXSeqDataSet(
  countData = count_matrix_GSE67333,
  sampleData = sample_data_GSE67333,
  design = ~ sample + exon + sex:exon + age_scaled:exon + condition:exon,
  featureID = tx2gene_GSE67333$transcript_id,
  groupID = tx2gene_GSE67333$gene_id
)
```

```{r}
# run DEXSeq pipeline
dxd_GSE67333 <- estimateSizeFactors(dxd_GSE67333)
dxd_GSE67333 <- estimateDispersions(dxd_GSE67333, BPPARAM = BPPARAM_GSE67333)

dxd_GSE67333 <- testForDEU(
  dxd_GSE67333,
  fullModel = ~ sample + exon + sex:exon + age_scaled:exon + condition:exon,
  reducedModel = ~ sample + exon + sex:exon + age_scaled:exon,
  BPPARAM = BPPARAM_GSE67333
)

dxd_GSE67333 <- estimateExonFoldChanges(dxd_GSE67333, fitExpToVar = "condition", BPPARAM = BPPARAM_GSE67333)
dxr_GSE67333 <- DEXSeqResults(dxd_GSE67333)
```

```{r}
# extract isoform-level and collapsed gene-level results
alpha_GSE67333 <- 0.05

res_isoforms_GSE67333 <- as.data.frame(dxr_GSE67333) |> 
  tibble::as_tibble() |> 
  dplyr::arrange(padj)

sig_isoforms_GSE67333 <- res_isoforms_GSE67333 |> 
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(padj), padj < alpha_GSE67333)

lfc_col_GSE67333 <- grep("^log2fold_", colnames(res_isoforms_GSE67333), value = TRUE)[1]

# collapse to gene-level keeping the most significant isoform per gene (preserves stat & log2FC for fgsea)
res_genes_GSE67333 <- res_isoforms_GSE67333 |> 
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(stat)) |> 
  dplyr::select(
    gene_id = groupID,
    isoform_id = featureID,
    stat,
    log2FC = dplyr::all_of(lfc_col_GSE67333),
    pvalue,
    padj
  ) |> 
  dplyr::group_by(gene_id) |> 
  dplyr::slice_min(order_by = pvalue, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |> 
  dplyr::ungroup() |> 
  dplyr::mutate(padj = p.adjust(pvalue, method = "fdr")) |> 
  dplyr::arrange(padj)

sig_genes_GSE67333 <- res_genes_GSE67333 |> 
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(padj), padj < alpha_GSE67333)

# summary
cat("Significant isoforms (FDR < 0.05):", nrow(sig_isoforms_GSE67333), "\n")
cat("Unique genes from significant isoforms:", length(unique(sig_isoforms_GSE67333$groupID)), "\n")
cat("Significant genes after gene-level FDR:", nrow(sig_genes_GSE67333), "\n")

# save results to results/DEXSeqGSE67333
readr::write_csv(res_isoforms_GSE67333, file.path(out_dir_GSE67333, "DEXSeq_all_isoforms_GSE67333.csv"))
readr::write_csv(sig_isoforms_GSE67333, file.path(out_dir_GSE67333, "DEXSeq_sig_isoforms_GSE67333.csv"))
readr::write_csv(res_genes_GSE67333, file.path(out_dir_GSE67333, "DEXSeq_all_genes_GSE67333.csv"))
readr::write_csv(sig_genes_GSE67333, file.path(out_dir_GSE67333, "DEXSeq_sig_genes_GSE67333.csv"))
saveRDS(dxr_GSE67333, file.path(out_dir_GSE67333, "dxr_GSE67333.rds"))
```

```{r}
# Inspect top 10 significant genes
head(res_genes_GSE67333, 10)
```

## Graphs and Analysis

```{r}
# 1. Dispersion estimation plot
plotDispEsts(dxd_GSE67333, main = "DEXSeq - Dispersion Estimation (GSE67333)")
```

```{r}
# 2. MA plot
plotMA(dxr_GSE67333, cex = 0.8, alpha = 0.05, main = "MA Plot - Differential Isoform Usage (GSE67333)")
```

```{r}
# 3. Volcano plot 
volcano_df_GSE67333 <- res_isoforms_GSE67333 |> 
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(padj), !is.na(.data[[lfc_col_GSE67333]])) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(
    sig = dplyr::case_when(
      padj < 0.05 & .data[[lfc_col_GSE67333]] > 0 ~ "Increased usage (padj < 0.05)",
      padj < 0.05 & .data[[lfc_col_GSE67333]] < 0 ~ "Decreased usage (padj < 0.05)",
      TRUE ~ "Not significant"
    )
  )

volcano_plot_GSE67333 <- ggplot(
  volcano_df_GSE67333,
  aes(x = .data[[lfc_col_GSE67333]], y = -log10(padj), color = sig)
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 1.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Increased usage (padj < 0.05)" = "#D55E00",
    "Decreased usage (padj < 0.05)" = "#0072B2",
    "Not significant" = "grey75"
  )) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted", color = "grey40") +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-10, 10)) +
  labs(
    title = "Differential Isoform Usage - GSE67333",
    subtitle = "X-axis zoomed to [-10, 10] to exclude unshrunken zero-count LFC boundary artifacts",
    x = paste0("Log2 Fold Change (", lfc_col_GSE67333, ")"),
    y = "-Log10 Adjusted P-value",
    color = "State"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

volcano_plot_GSE67333
ggsave(file.path(out_dir_GSE67333, "volcano_plot_GSE67333.png"), plot = volcano_plot_GSE67333, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
# 4. Per-gene fraction of significant isoforms histogram (Optional challenge #3 in exercise)
per_gene_frac_GSE67333 <- res_isoforms_GSE67333 |> 
  dplyr::transmute(
    gene_id = groupID,
    isoform_id = featureID,
    sig = !is.na(padj) & padj < alpha_GSE67333
  ) |> 
  dplyr::group_by(gene_id) |> 
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_iso = dplyr::n(),
    n_sig = sum(sig),
    frac_sig = n_sig / n_iso
  ) |> 
  dplyr::ungroup() |> 
  dplyr::filter(frac_sig > 0)

frac_plot_GSE67333 <- ggplot(per_gene_frac_GSE67333, aes(x = frac_sig)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "#009E73", color = "white") +
  labs(
    title = "DEXSeq: Per-Gene Fraction of Significant Isoforms (GSE67333)",
    x = "Fraction of significant isoforms per gene",
    y = "Number of genes"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

frac_plot_GSE67333
ggsave(file.path(out_dir_GSE67333, "per_gene_isoform_fraction_GSE67333.png"), plot = frac_plot_GSE67333, width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
# 5. Relative isoform usage profile for the top significant gene
top_gene_raw_GSE67333 <- res_genes_GSE67333$gene_id[1]

norm_counts_GSE67333 <- DEXSeq::featureCounts(dxd_GSE67333, normalized = TRUE)
gene_rows_GSE67333 <- grep(paste0("^", top_gene_raw_GSE67333, ":"), rownames(norm_counts_GSE67333), value = TRUE)

iso_usage_df_GSE67333 <- as.data.frame(norm_counts_GSE67333[gene_rows_GSE67333, , drop = FALSE]) |> 
  tibble::rownames_to_column("gene_tx") |> 
  tidyr::separate(gene_tx, into = c("gene_id", "transcript_id"), sep = ":") |> 
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(gene_id, transcript_id),
    names_to = "sample_id",
    values_to = "norm_count"
  ) |> 
  dplyr::left_join(metadata_GSE67333, by = "sample_id") |> 
  dplyr::group_by(sample_id) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(
    gene_total = sum(norm_count),
    isoform_prop = dplyr::if_else(gene_total > 0, norm_count / gene_total, 0)
  ) |> 
  dplyr::ungroup()

iso_switch_plot_GSE67333 <- ggplot(
  iso_usage_df_GSE67333,
  aes(x = transcript_id, y = isoform_prop, fill = condition)
) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.75, outlier.shape = NA, position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
  geom_point(
    aes(color = condition),
    position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.15, dodge.width = 0.8),
    size = 2, alpha = 0.85
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  labs(
    title = paste("Relative Isoform Usage (GSE67333):", top_gene_raw_GSE67333),
    x = "Transcript ID",
    y = "Relative Isoform Proportion (% of Gene Expression)",
    fill = "Condition",
    color = "Condition"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))

iso_switch_plot_GSE67333
ggsave(
  file.path(out_dir_GSE67333, paste0("isoform_usage_", top_gene_raw_GSE67333, "_GSE67333.png")),
  plot = iso_switch_plot_GSE67333, width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300
)
```
